verdict.rationale: Restate ships as a single self-contained binary with a CLI installable via npx (verified in probe), runs as containers/serverless/VMs/K8s pods, and is designed for programmatic/headless invocation via HTTP and typed clients with introspection via CLI/SQL API — all fitting CI/automation use. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g. GitHub Actions) or documented exit-code/automation-friendly CLI behavior, and no independent hands-on CI report beyond vendor docs and probes.
